messages:
maria: Heads-up 1: I'm coordinating a small docs push to standardize SDK streaming + pagination examples across py/ts/go. Found inconsistent examples and a param rename (retries -> max_attempts). I opened a tracking PR and three language PRs. Need quick reviews and a merge order.
jeff: Can you drop links?
maria: Sure: tracker https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/744; py https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/742; ts https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/743; go https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/741
kai: Noted. Go snippet currently uses older StreamUntil loop which no longer exists on runtime. New server returns Recv() -> (Chunk, done, error). Example I propose: ```go // simple streaming reader client := inference.NewClient(apiKey) ctx := context.Background() stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req) for { chunk, done, err := stream.Recv() if err != nil { log.Fatalf("stream error: %v", err) } fmt.Print(chunk.Text) if done { break } } ```
alisa: For TS we should prefer async-iterator style and show cancellation. Proposed: ```ts const ac = new AbortController() const stream = client.stream(req, { signal: ac.signal, max_attempts: 2 }) for await (const chunk of stream) { if (shouldStop()) { ac.abort() break } process.stdout.write(chunk.text) } ```
jeff: Python needs to show rename to max_attempts and how to paginate/resume if partial output. Sketch: ```py # streaming + retry + resume client = RedwoodClient(api_key) with client.stream(req, max_attempts=3) as s: for chunk in s: print(chunk.text, end="") # if interrupted: save cursor = chunk.cursor # later: client.stream(req, cursor=cursor) ```
devex: Important: add a short migration note in SDK changelog and a redirect page so docs search for `retries` points to `max_attempts`. Also update the API reference examples.
ci-bot: CI: docs-lint failed on tracker PR 744: missing language hint for codeblock and a couple long lines.
maria: Thanks CI. Kai please add language on code fences and wrap lines at ~100. Also add a one-line explanation for the `done` bool in Go.
kai: On it. I'll also change variable names to be idiomatic and rerun tests.
alisa: I'll modify TS PR to explicitly state that streaming + pagination are orthogonal; include a line about using cursor tokens or resume tokens if the client supports them. Also will make the example show `for await` with a small processing function.
jeff: I added a tiny migration section to the Python page showing how old `retries` maps to `max_attempts` and an example wrapper `def stream_with_retries(..., retries=1): return client.stream(..., max_attempts=retries)` for backwards compat.
maria: Proposed merge order: 1) python 742 after jeff's blurb + CI, 2) typescript 743 after alisa updates, 3) go 741 after kai's lint fix, 4) tracker 744 once all are merged. Ping me when green.
ci-bot: Update: PR 741 (go) now passed docs tests after adding codeblock language and wrapping lines.
kai: Pushed fix, PTAL. I left the comment: "done indicates server finished sending; still check err."
jeff: PR 742 CI green. I also added a short example linking to the SDK changelog entry.
alisa: PR 743 updated and linted. I added a short note about pagination tokens in the streaming context: "if you need to resume after an interruption, persist the last chunk cursor and pass as cursor in a new request." CI green.
maria: Merging in that order now. Waiting 10 minutes for dispute window.
ci-bot: Merges complete: 742, 743, 741, then 744. Docsite build success: https://docs.redwood.ai/notes/streaming-pagination-snippets-update
maria: All shipped. I'll post a brief changelog email and update the release tracker row. Thanks team! :rocket:
